description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1262/16 of 13.11.2022
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. The first notice declares land needed for a power distribution center construction project, providing detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and ownership claims. The second notice is an amendment to a previous land acquisition declaration, correcting land name references. Both notices focus exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reforms, or other specialized categories.
